description: Land Acquisition - Makura,  Warakapola D/S Division, Kegalle District - Nadungamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha  District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land lots, locations, extents, and ownership details. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it concerns "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
